column3: Clears the 16 effect-slot active fields, four repeat-slot counters, and the effect-system state flag.
Copies and normalizes an input byte sequence, then searches the selected spell-definition group for matching bytes.
Builds three restriction bits from the spell record's threshold, mode mask, and cost check.
Allocates an effect slot from a spell definition, schedules repeats, initializes velocity, and invokes its target and visual callbacks.
Copies actor X/Z and chooses actor Y or ground-height minus model radius for the effect position.
Copies actor X/Z and chooses ground height or actor Y plus half model height for the effect position.
Copies actor X/Z and sets Y from upper model extent plus configured offset.
Rotates a positive local Z offset by actor yaw and places the effect at the actor's middle height.
Rotates a positive local Z offset by actor yaw and places the effect at its upper height.
Rotates a negative local Z offset by actor yaw and places the effect at its upper height.
Uses the effect's target when present and copies its X/Z and model-dependent lower Y.
Chooses random radius and yaw, rotates the offset, and places it around the actor.
Derives distance from target separation or model radius, rotates a 1.5:1 X/Z offset, then places the effect.
Rotates a 380-unit local Z offset and adds scaled X/Y/Z offsets to actor position.
Advances repeat schedules and all 16 active effects, resolves target hits, updates linked visuals, and handles effect-system end state.
Steers velocity toward a target, applies optional gravity, integrates position, and handles ground contact.
Integrates vertical velocity with optional gravity, handles ground contact, and follows target X/Z when configured.
Tests eligible player or enemy actors against the effect's position and configured radius, returning one in range.
Returns player or an active enemy after checking the slot-specific hit mask, without a distance test.
Invokes the target search only when bit one of the effect flags is set.
Calculates damage from definition and caster, adjusts it for target state and random bonus, then calls player or enemy damage.
Adds a bounded amount to the target's current resource using its configured maximum, then reports the amount.
Subtracts a fraction of one actor resource and adds it to the opposing actor's bounded resource.
Calls the player or enemy damage routine with amount zero and hit flag four.
For enemy targets disables/removes the actor; for the player applies damage equal to four times a model stat.
Clears the actor status bits and restores affected scale and three model-derived values.
Calls the module's effect-damage handler, then clears the target's statuses.
Chooses the active enemy with the smallest absolute yaw difference from the caster aiming direction.
Targets the player for an enemy caster, otherwise chooses the first active enemy among six slots.
Copies the effect's caster pointer into its target pointer.
Sets status bit one, halves actor scale, and starts the corresponding timed status effect.
Computes the amount used by the effect-damage handler from base value and caster or target level.
Scales visual dimensions from model size and calls the effect-object constructor.
Creates the cast visual, optional particle effect, and optional sound from the cast definition.
Creates a visual and optional sound for a timed effect step.
Creates a visual, optional particle effect, and optional sound at the hit actor.
Creates an effect visual, optional particle effect, and optional sound for the ground-contact callback.
Decrements all active status timers and restores changed actor values when each timer expires.
Tests the bit for an effect slot against the actor's recorded hit mask.
Sets the bit for an effect slot in the actor's recorded hit mask.
Clears the player hit mask and the six enemy hit masks.
Clears one effect-slot bit from the player and six enemy hit masks.
Combines the effect flag, random threshold, and target relationship into a value from the outcome table.
Checks effect flags and target type, then compares a random value with the status-specific chance table.
Assigns a random duration to the selected target status, with different ranges for self and other targets.
